{{Top|canon=Weather scanner vane}}
[[File:Weather_scanner_vane.png|thumb|300px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] clinging to a weather vane]]
'''Weather vanes''' were measuring instruments used on the outside of buildings that collected [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] data. At [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], weather vanes were used to give out storm warnings and allow for changes to the inside atmosphere. They had large [[Processor/Legends|processor]] units attached to them on the inside of the building. They were also used on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once clung to one following the [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel on Cloud City]],<ref name="CL 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> until he was saved by the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> They were part of the city's flotation system and had [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detecting the velocity of wind and the content of local [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]].<ref name="CCG weather vane light">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Weather Vane (Light)}}</ref>
